notes: Upcoming: every todo due after today, by day, like on the web.
Add a todo with the round + button at the bottom right of Today and Upcoming.
Reporting replaces Stats: a log of the todos you added, updated, completed and deleted, by day, like on the web.
Filter Reporting by action and date, and download what it shows as a PDF to save or share.
Integrations in Profile, with ChatGPT coming soon.
A new dark look, built on deep, neutral grays.
The Dooist orange on buttons and checkboxes, and on today's date in the date strip.
Calendar: connect Google Calendar, see your Google events in Today, and switch todo sync on or off.
Account: see your picture and email, change your name, set a password, or delete your account.
Notifications: tap the bell at the top of Profile.
Delete a todo from its details, with the trash icon beside its name.
Smoother swiping in the date strip and time pickers, with a steady tick.
Add time now starts at the current time.
Check for Updates opens its own page, with what's new in each update.
